opportunities.title: Conference Attendance Award
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Open to Undergraduate & Masters, Postgraduate, Full and Fellow members of The Physiological Society. Postgraduate, Full and Fellow member applicants must be submitting/presenting an abstract at the meeting they wish to attend.
opportunities.summary: Funding to support member engagement at the Society's own meetings and, where funding allows, attendance at Society-sponsored events. Covers registration and meeting dinner(s), with a contribution toward travel and accommodation on presentation of receipts. Members can apply to attend up to three meetings with one application.

opportunities.title: Education and Teaching Award
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Open to members of The Physiological Society. The applicant's host institution must be willing to administer the award.
opportunities.summary: Supports members wishing to develop new educational resources or conduct a piece of publishable educational research that addresses a key question in physiological education. Funds must be used within 12 months of the grant award date.

opportunities.title: Research and Knowledge Exchange Award
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Open to members of The Physiological Society. The applicant's host institution must be willing to administer the award.
opportunities.summary: Supports members wishing to conduct pilot studies, develop a new technique or finalise a project, as well as supporting activities to promote knowledge transfer and impact. Funds must be used within 12 months of the grant award date.

opportunities.title: Institutional Engagement Award
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Open to Society Representatives and members. Applications must be supported by a Society Representative or a Fellow.
opportunities.summary: Provides funding to support Society Representatives and members to host events at their organisation, including internal conferences, teaching symposia, seminars or outreach events.

opportunities.title: Unlocking Futures Fund
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Open to postdoctoral researchers who are members of The Physiological Society.
opportunities.summary: Provides additional support to postdoctoral researchers to help them achieve their full potential. Funds should be used within 12 months of receipt, supporting the activity outlined in the application.

opportunities.title: Equity, Diversity and Inclusion Fund
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Open to Undergraduate & Masters, Postgraduate, Full members or Fellows of The Physiological Society in their second year of membership or longer.
opportunities.summary: Provides support for Members to run activities that address the principles of Equity, Diversity and Inclusion. Intended for projects that directly investigate or address inclusion and diversity issues in the physiological sciences in either teaching or research. Funds must be used within 6 months of the award date.
